name: iBorShell
description: iBorShell: a secure SSH terminal for DBX — interactive sessions, SFTP file transfer, multi-host exec, clone session and live server stats. Fork of jinpy's Terminal plugin.
releaseNotes: iBorShell 1.0.1: signed-release refresh of 1.0.0 (fork of jinpy's Terminal io.dbx.ssh 0.7.9-beta.2, repacked as net.iborshell). All platform packages are Ed25519-signed (key_id net.iborshell). Command history panel removed; adds Multi Exec panel, Clone Session and a live CPU/ping/disk stats strip.
